scope: Development replay on the declared held-out split. Corpus previously used in development. Actual Headroom lossless compression; modeled costs, frozen answers, zero recovery overhead. No full-proxy or answer-quality comparison.

compache.historical_coverage_basis: Fraction of labeled historical requirements with one complete sufficient evidence alternative retained before recovery; AND within each alternative, OR across alternatives. Unknown requirements and direct lookup requirements are excluded, with unknown runs reported separately.
compache.interpretation: Modeled RAG-only cost in base-input-token equivalents. Byte-based token estimates; no Codex overhead or provider bill calibration. Recovery uses frozen task-label alternatives as an evaluation oracle, never runtime knowledge. No answer-quality replay or causal test. Unavailable bodies are unpriced; totals cover visible projection text only, not the hidden full workload. Recovery overhead is assumed zero: no expansion calls or restored content are inserted. Known missing requirements are still reported; frozen answers are not quality evidence.
